description.value: Swiss Bakery is a Vancouver institution established in 1993, now operating as Luminous Foods Inc. while retaining the Swiss Bakery name at its two locations. The UBC outlet on University Boulevard offers artisan breads, gourmet pretzels, frissants, hand-made pastries, and a seasonal lunch menu — a worthwhile stop for cyclists riding through the UBC campus area. Wholesale and catering services are also available from this location.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 4m; rack at 12m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 21m; stands (4 spaces) at 30m; rack (28 spaces) at 37m. Total: 34 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the UBC location at 5970 University Blvd is active, with phone 604-262-5393 matching OSM's +16042625393. The site lists artisan bread, pretzels, frissants, pastries, cakes, and a seasonal lunch menu, confirming food-stop value for cyclists. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name 'Swiss Bakery Catering & Wholesale' does not match the website's UBC-specific branding 'Swiss Bakery UBC'; the wholesale/catering suffix may confuse directory users expecting a retail stop.
Legal entity name changed to Luminous Foods Inc. (dba Swiss Bakery) as of the company's 30th anniversary — OSM record does not reflect this.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) confirmed from website or OSM tags; a site visit would be needed to verify.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active artisan bakery with a 30-year track record, located on the UBC campus — a natural waypoint for cyclists on the University Boulevard corridor. Sells fresh bread, pastries, and prepared lunch items that are practical cyclist provisions.
enrichment_extras.notes: The bakery has two Vancouver locations: this UBC outlet (5970 University Blvd) and the original Mount Pleasant location (143 3rd Ave E, phone 604-736-8785). The OSM record is specific to the UBC branch.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM maps shop=bakery to Groceries; this is primarily an artisan bakery and café, not a grocery store. The Groceries category may overstate the range of supplies available, but fresh bread and pastries are legitimate cyclist provisions.

wow_evidence: Vancouver institution established in 1993… two locations
